findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service · Private data: get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial · Public sink: rotate_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service · Private data: get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial · Public sink: rotate_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

labels.name: get_trial_offer
labels.description: Read the adjustable free-use offer, wallet authentication, allowance and explicit paid transition.

labels.name: get_trial_access
labels.description: Get the service request and standard wallet-auth instructions. First signed execution enrolls automatically; no wallet funds or payment required.

labels.name: rotate_trial
labels.description: Write: request a wallet-rotation challenge with old_wallet/new_wallet/request_id; then submit old_proof/new_proof signed with both keys. Usage is preserved.

labels.name: referral_accept_terms
labels.description: Accept a newer version of the referral terms to keep earning. arguments: terms_version and terms_digest from referral_program. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

labels.name: referral_acknowledge
labels.description: Mark notices already served by referral_notices as read up to a cursor. arguments: cursor (integer) and optional private_cursor. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

labels.name: referral_notices
labels.description: Read published program notices and the referrer's private account events. arguments: optional cursor, limit (1-50) and private_cursor. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

labels.name: referral_receipts
labels.description: Page through a referrer's commission receipts, oldest first. arguments: optional cursor (last seen) and limit (1-50). Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

labels.name: referral_register
labels.description: Register a wallet as a Mekler referrer and receive a referral code. arguments: terms_version and terms_digest from referral_program, which explicitly accept those exact terms. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is auth

labels.name: referral_rotate
labels.description: Move a referral registration to a new wallet without losing history. arguments: old_wallet and new_wallet; then send proof (old wallet) and new_proof (new wallet). Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

labels.name: referral_status
labels.description: Read a registered referrer's code, referral link, accepted versus current terms and whether action is required. arguments: none. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

labels.name: referral_program
labels.description: Read current Mekler referral availability, terms and commission offer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, search_listings, update_listing_preferences · Private data: start_ownership_proof, confirm_ownership_proof, update_listing_preferences, get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial, referral_accept_terms, referral_acknowledge, referral_notices, referral_receipts, referral_register, referral_rotate, referral_status · Public sink: start_ownership_proof, rotate_trial, referral_rotate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, search_listings, update_listing_preferences · Private data: start_ownership_proof, confirm_ownership_proof, update_listing_preferences, get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial, referral_accept_terms, referral_acknowledge, referral_notices, referral_receipts, referral_register, referral_rotate, referral_status · Public sink: start_ownership_proof, rotate_trial, referral_rotate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "referral_accept_terms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Mekler referral accept terms. Omit proof to receive a standard SIWx signing challenge; registration/terms changes explicitly accept the exact terms digest. Rotation requires both proofs." → after: "Accept a newer version of the referral terms to keep earning. arguments: terms_version and terms_digest from referral_program. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
